analysis.title: Factors associated with receiving SLDP among eligible patients
analysis.method: Mixed-effects logistic regression, random intercept for facility (264 eligible patients, 36 facilities).
analysis.finding: No factor is significantly associated with receiving SLDP at the 5% level. Facility intraclass correlation = 0.108: about 11% of the variation in receiving SLDP lies between facilities, so facility practice matters.

analysis.title: SLDP coverage among eligible patients by subgroup
analysis.method: Proportion given SLDP with exact (Clopper-Pearson) 95% confidence intervals.
analysis.finding: Subgroups whose interval sits clearly below the others are the ones to target in supervision.

analysis.title: Agreement between calculated eligibility and the clinician's decision

rows: Clinician said eligible, form said not
Clinician said not eligible, form said eligible

analysis.finding: Kappa 0.64 indicates substantial agreement (Landis and Koch). Overrides in either direction should be reviewed against the exclusion criteria.

analysis.title: SLDP dose received per kilogram, by age group
analysis.method: Median and IQR of mg base per kg; Kruskal-Wallis test across age groups.
analysis.finding: Overall median 0.246 mg/kg against a 0.25 target. Difference between age groups: Kruskal-Wallis p < 0.001. Doses outside the range point to the dosing band used for that age.

analysis.title: Adverse event incidence in the CEM cohort, SLDP given vs not given
analysis.method: Cumulative incidence per patient with exact 95% CI; risk ratio with log-normal CI; Fisher's exact test.
analysis.finding: Risk ratio 0.69 (95% CI 0.27 to 1.75), Fisher p = 0.564. No evidence of excess adverse events with SLDP.

analysis.title: Haemoglobin change from Day 0 to Day 3
analysis.method: Paired comparison: Wilcoxon signed-rank test and paired t-test CI for the mean change.
analysis.finding: Mean change -0.38 g/dL. 3 patient(s) had a fall of 2 g/dL or more, each of which needs a Form 3 report and clinical review.

analysis.title: Linear mixed model of haemoglobin (Day 0 and Day 3)
analysis.method: Linear mixed model with a random intercept per patient, adjusted for age and sex (181 measurements, 98 patients). Uses patients with only one value as well.

rows: Extra Day 3 change when SLDP given

analysis.finding: The interaction term (0.04 g/dL, p = 0.837) tests whether the Day 3 change differs when SLDP was given; a significant negative value would suggest SLDP-related haemolysis.

analysis.title: Time to first adverse event within 28 days (Kaplan-Meier)
analysis.method: Kaplan-Meier cumulative incidence from Day 0; patients without an event censored at last completed contact; log-rank test.

analysis.title: Cox proportional hazards model for a first adverse event
analysis.method: Cox regression adjusted for age and sex; proportional hazards checked with Schoenfeld residuals.
analysis.finding: Proportional hazards check: global Schoenfeld test p = 0.022. The assumption may not hold; read the hazard ratios with caution and rely on the Kaplan-Meier curves.

analysis.title: Retention to Day 28
analysis.method: Proportion completing Day 28 with exact 95% CI.

rows: Patients whose Day 28 window has closed

analysis.finding: Retention below 80% weakens the safety estimates; trace lost patients through the alternative contact.

analysis.title: Telephone contact success by attempt number
analysis.method: Proportion reached per attempt; chi-squared test for trend.
analysis.finding: Test for trend across attempts: p < 0.001. If later attempts still succeed often, keep calling before marking a patient lost.

analysis.title: Day 3 positivity and gametocyte carriage, Day 0 vs Day 3
analysis.method: Paired proportions; McNemar test for the change in gametocyte carriage.

rows: Patients with microscopy on Day 0 and Day 3

analysis.finding: Gametocyte carriage went from 64% on Day 0 to 0% on Day 3 (McNemar p = 0.008). A fall is consistent with the transmission-blocking aim of SLDP.

analysis.title: Missing values in key fields
analysis.method: Share of records with the field empty, counted only where the form asks the question (SLDP dose among patients given SLDP, CEM consent at CEM sites, ACT type among Pf-positive patients).
analysis.finding: Fields above 5% missing should be raised with the facilities concerned.
